ideas.pitch: An automated data profiling and integrity rating tool designed to ingest raw event datasets, flag data quality anomalies, and auto-generate comprehensive exploratory reports.
ideas.problem_statement: Perform an end-to-end data analysis by cleaning, transforming, exploring patterns, and identifying key insights from a real-world dataset provided by organizers.
ideas.title: CleanInsights Automated EDA and Data Integrity Suite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the explicit event requirement for thorough data cleaning, profiling, and documentation with automated checks that save hours of manual code writing.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning and statistical analysis app that predicts target business metrics and uses SHAP values to present clear, interpretable feature importance to stakeholders.
ideas.problem_statement: Perform quantitative and statistical analysis, explore relationships, and turn raw datasets into clear insights and data-driven decisions.
ideas.title: XGBoost Business Driver and SHAP Explainer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines predictive modeling with clinical-grade explainability (SHAP), scoring high on quantitative rigor and actionable recommendations.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered log analysis dashboard that parses raw event logs, detects behavioral anomalies, and highlights critical operational bottlenecks in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: Exploring patterns, trends, and relationships to solve real-world problems by turning raw datasets into clear insights.
ideas.title: LogAnomaly: Intelligent Operational Log Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles raw log datasets with anomaly detection algorithms and an interactive dashboard, matching the winning pattern of a live-working analytics product.

ideas.pitch: An interactive analytics dashboard and simulation tool that maps environmental species data, tracks ecosystem health metrics, and visualizes longitudinal trends.
ideas.problem_statement: Building meaningful visualizations and dashboards and identifying key insights and actionable recommendations from real-world datasets.
ideas.title: EcoMetric Ecosystem Simulator and Public Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers a polished public-facing dashboard with rich visualizations, mirroring proven winners focused on public awareness and ecosystem analytics.

ideas.pitch: A natural language interface that queries structured datasets and pushes pre-formatted visualization specs directly to reporting platforms in seconds.
ideas.problem_statement: Building meaningful visualizations and dashboards and presenting analysis and findings effectively to business stakeholders.
ideas.title: Text2Tableau Automated Reporting Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages agentic workflows to automate the most time-consuming part of analytics hackathons: building visual dashboards.
